$comment: Fingerless black gloves. Measured on ref/views/body_2.png with a metre grid
Sides follow docs/HANDEDNESS.md: +X is her left and is the side of the
Zapper, the arm bands and the long sleeve; the tattooed arm is -X.
keyed to the alpha bbox; panel x is mirrored with respect to this frame.
The two arms differ on the sheet: on the tattooed arm (image-left, -X) the
sleeve is cut at y=1.115 and on the Zapper-side arm (image-right, +X) it runs
up over the elbow to y=1.208, right under the lower black band. topY is
the short one, longTopY the long one, and belts.rigSide decides which
arm gets which so the pair follows if the bands are mirrored.
The base spec's topY of 1.052 is a third of the way up the forearm, not
'most of' it: the wrist joint is at y=0.988 and the elbow at 1.181.
The rolled wrist cuff reads between y=0.945 and y=0.990 on the sheet, so
knuckleT is in units of the wrist->hand vector: body.ts runs the finger
stub out to 1.42, and the cut at 1.14 leaves the last third bare, which
matches the bare fingers below y=0.885 on the sheet.
